title: 第一卷 第6章 觉醒圣体，生命的律动！
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

帝子殿之上，清冷的月轮高挂。

水雾弥漫，纵横万里！

天地之间，朦胧未分，在皎洁月色之下，仿若一条银白色的天河高挂。

髣髴兮若轻云之蔽月，飘摇兮若流风之回雪！

林清雅的洛天圣体，觉醒了！

这天地异象，像是一记响亮的耳光，抽在了林晶晶的脸上。

她自傲的洛水灵体，在洛天圣体面前，犹如渣滓！

“这股气息……是林清雅？”林晶晶呢喃自语，却又连忙摇头，“不，不可能，她只是林家旁支的一个小杂种，从小就被我踩在脚下，她怎么可能拥有如此强悍的体质？”

“我不信，我不相信！”

林晶晶扑向姜无痕，神色恍惚道：“姜无痕，这都是你搞出来的障眼法，是用来骗我的对不对？”

“我错了，我向你道歉，你别再吓唬我了好不好？”她抓着姜无痕的胳膊，声音颤抖，“我们就当昨天的事情都没发生过，回到以前那样……好不好？”

“只要你休了林清雅那个小贱人，我就同意嫁给你，谁都不能拆散我们……”

话音未落，姜无痕一脚将她踹开。

“你踏马倒是一点儿亏都不吃，还想让老子继续给你当舔狗？”姜无痕一脸厌恶，不屑道，“就你这幅德行，连我帝子殿里的侍女都比不上！”

“我当初是瞎了眼，居然舔你这样的破鞋！”

姜无痕看向林晶晶的眼神中，充满了厌恶。

“不，不是的……”林晶晶挣扎着爬起来，匆忙解释道，“都是陆晨花言巧语欺骗我，我也只是犯了一个所有年轻女孩都会犯的错误而已，又没干别的什么，你为什么就不能原谅我呢？”

“而且，你怎么知道……我跟陆晨睡的时候，心里想的不是你？”

话音未落，一股强大的威压降下，赫然锁定了林晶晶。

她并未接触到姜无痕，身体仿佛被定格般，再难动弹分毫。

不远处，一位身材丰腴，成熟知性的美妇人缓步而来，看向林晶晶的眼神中，满是冰冷与阴沉。

“雪姨？”姜无痕认出了对方，问道，“你怎么来了？”

被称作‘雪姨’的女人，是自幼跟随姜临天的侍女，在一些场合上，她的言行都能直接代表姜临天。

除此之外，她还是一位圣人王！

“小无痕，我奉家主之命而来，对你贴身保护！”雪姨解释，随即看向林晶晶，“小无痕，我不知道你是怎么想的，但这样一个水性杨花，又蠢又坏的女人，不值得你在她身上浪费时间。”

“你有更重要的事情要去做！”

她作为姜临天的心腹，显然是知道系统的。

“雪姨，你说得对，这个人就交给你了。”姜无痕点头，沉声道，“我不想再见到她，你知道该怎么做。”

说完，他转身回了帝子殿。

雪姨见状，顿感意外。

这孩子，怎么变得这么听话了？

反观林晶晶，顿时脸色苍白，不断呼喊着姜无痕的名字。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Above the Emperor's Palace, the cold moon hung high.

The water mist fills the air and stretches thousands of miles!

Between heaven and earth, there is no distinction. Under the bright moonlight, it looks like a silver-white Milky Way hanging high.

It seems as if the moon is covered by light clouds, and flutters like the snow covered by the flowing wind!

Lin Qingya's Luotian Holy Body has awakened!

This strange phenomenon of heaven and earth was like a loud slap on Lin Jingjing's face.

Her proud Luoshui spirit body was like scum in front of Luotian holy body!

"This aura... is Lin Qingya?" Lin Jingjing murmured to herself, but quickly shook her head, "No, it's impossible. She is just a little bastard from a branch of the Lin family. I have stepped under my feet since she was a child. How can she have such a strong physique?"

"I don't believe it, I don't believe it!"

Lin Jingjing pounced on Jiang Wuhen and said with a dazed expression: "Jiang Wuhen, this is all a deceit you created to deceive me, right?"

"I was wrong, I apologize to you, please stop scaring me, okay?" She grabbed Jiang Wuhen's arm, her voice trembling, "Let's just pretend that what happened yesterday never happened, and go back to how we were before... okay?"

"As long as you divorce that little bitch Lin Qingya, I will agree to marry you. No one can break us up..."

Before she finished speaking, Jiang Wuhen kicked her away.

"You don't suffer any losses when you ride a horse, but you still want me to continue to be your licking dog?" Jiang Wuhen said with disgust on his face, "Your virtue is not even comparable to that of the maids in my emperor's palace!"

"I was so blind that I actually licked a broken shoe like yours!"

Jiang Wuhen looked at Lin Jingjing with eyes full of disgust.

"No, it's not..." Lin Jingjing struggled to get up and hurriedly explained, "It was all Lu Chen's sweet words that deceived me. I just made a mistake that all young girls make, and nothing else. Why can't you forgive me?"

"Besides, how do you know...when I slept with Lu Chen, I wasn't thinking about you?"

Before he finished speaking, a powerful pressure came down and locked onto Lin Jingjing.

She didn't come into contact with Jiang Wuhen, and her body seemed to be frozen, making it difficult to move at all.

Not far away, a plump, mature and intellectual beautiful woman came slowly, looking at Lin Jingjing with cold and gloomy eyes.

"Aunt Xue?" Jiang Wuhen recognized the other party and asked, "Why are you here?"

The woman known as 'Aunt Snow' is the maid who has followed Jiang Lintian since childhood. On some occasions, her words and deeds can directly represent Jiang Lintian.

In addition, she is also a saint king!

"Xiao Wuhen, I am here under the order of the master of the family to protect you!" Aunt Xue explained, and then looked at Lin Jingjing, "Xiao Wuhen, I don't know what you think, but such a wanton, stupid and bad woman is not worth your time to waste on her."

"You have more important things to do!"

As Jiang Lintian's confidant, she obviously knows the system.

"Aunt Xue, you are right, I will leave this person to you." Jiang Wuhen nodded and said solemnly, "I don't want to see her again, you know what to do."

After saying that, he turned around and returned to the Emperor's Palace.

Aunt Xue was surprised when she saw this.

How did this child become so obedient?

On the other hand, Lin Jingjing suddenly turned pale and kept calling Jiang Wuhen's name.
